statements.reason: Drycleaning solvent is specified, but its type and equivalents are not identified.
statements.statement: The cleaning agent generally specified for grease or oil on metal parts is drycleaning solvent (SD), type II, or equivalent.

evidence_quotes: Do not clean CDR valve with solvent.
statements.reason: The prohibition applies to solvent used on the CDR valve.
statements.statement: Drycleaning solvent (SD), type II, or equivalent must not be used to clean the CDR valve.

evidence_quotes:
Do not clean CDR valve with solvent.
This will damage the diaphragm in-
side the CDR valve.
statements.reason: The caution states this consequence directly.
statements.statement: Cleaning the CDR valve with solvent will damage the diaphragm inside the CDR valve.

evidence_quotes:
Wiping with a rag
is the only authorized method of
cleaning.

c. Remove and wipe off the CDR valve
and hoses with a rag.
statements.reason: Wiping with a rag is the only authorized cleaning method, and the procedure includes the valve and hoses.
statements.statement: The authorized CDR valve cleaning method is to wipe the CDR valve and the CDR valve hoses with a rag only.
